goal: PCI DSS code check: card data handling, storage and logging rules checked in the code.
use: PCI DSS code check: card data handling, storage and logging rules checked in the code. Use when code handles payment card data or payment flows.

steps.note: Find the card data. List where card numbers, CVV or expiry dates appear.
Check storage. Flag card data stored after authorisation, or in logs.
Check transmission. Flag card data sent without strong encryption.
Check the payment provider. Note whether card entry is kept off the team's servers.
Report. Each finding with file and line, the requirement it breaks and the fix.
